name: fix129_montera_ambush
verifies: fix-129 (owner: Daryl_OneByOneOrc near Montera; the lured orc guard sat peacefully at the rebels' campfire and the hero's hit on it turned the rebels on the hero): Daryl and RebWarrior_05#3ecf9c3f are Reb but members of the orc enclave Montera; G3 GetPoliticalAttitude reads the own alignment, so they and the Montera orcs are enemies. The orc sent to the ambush point (routine RebAmbush, flag Montera_Orc_03_Treat) is attacked by the rebels and does not survive; the rebels stay non-hostile to the hero.
notes: attitudeto:X,Y = X's attitude toward Y (ScenarioRunner.Probe.cs, fix-129); politics:X = toward a probe orc / probe rebel without enclave (fix-94). Before fix-129 politics:Daryl was Friendly/Friendly (the enclave's Orc), the orc lived on at the fire. If the orc reaches the ambush point within 5 m before the rebels get it, its Important info (BPANKRATZ3860) talks to the hero and attacks him (Enemy); the hero has god mode. fix-135: the rebels do attack at once (Daryl and the orc fight from the bring on), but one rebel holds the attack token on an NPC target (CombatCoordinator, G3 Active/Passive) and the duel of two level-10+ warriors takes ~85 s (editor run 2026-10-19): the 60 s wait was too short.
